name: Site gate and fencing

gaps.what: Gate and Fencing (820m x 2.5m; electric telescopic door 2x; fence gate 6x; 3.0m x 250m + 2.4m x 250m steel grating fence)
gaps.why: No published rate per metre for 2.5 m fencing or steel grating fence, and no datasheet for the specified steel grating fence; GEAPL is an Indian manufacturer and is not evidence of supply to this project.
gaps.next_action: Source a Malaysian fence/grating supplier datasheet and a published RM/m rate for perimeter fencing and gates.

gaps.what: Gate and Fencing (820m x 2.5m; electric telescopic door 2x; fence gate 6x; 3.0m x 250m + 2.4m x 250m steel grating fence)
gaps.why: The 820 m, gate counts and 250 m grating lengths are bidder-supplied design figures, not evidence.
gaps.next_action: Do not present these figures as sourced facts.

gaps.why: No sized, located and dated site-gate/fencing BOQ or award for the 7-unit GEG plant or a Sabah 132/33/11 kV connection was found. The only printed prices are Klang Valley 2026 QS guidance rates, not a project quotation; the DOSH 2007 guideline gives a 1800 mm minimum but no price.
gaps.next_action: Obtain the actual gate/fencing quantities and priced BOQ from the contractor; keep the Klang Valley 2026 guidance rates labelled as non-project rates.

gaps.why: No published RM/m rate for site fencing was read; the JKR 2025 schedule-of-rates page that prints fence rates could not be fetched by WebFetch (direct and r.jina.ai both failed), so its figures were not recorded.
gaps.next_action: Fetch the JKR JKR20800-0246-25 schedule directly and record the dated security-fence RM/m rate

notes: Analysed core item from the owner-supplied equipment/facilities list for a 7-unit gas-engine power plant. Evidence categories present: sources, specifications, vendors. Checked for prices, projects, standards, patents, drawings and materials; where absent the gaps record says so.
